Researchers built a random number generator - a machine that spits out 1s and 0s with no pattern, pure chance, like a coin flip. They ran it thousands and thousands of times just to prove it was truly even.

Then they brought in a person and asked them to simply want more 1s than 0s - nothing physical, just desire.

Every single time, the machine shifted in the direction the person wanted. Not by a little. Consistently.

This is the experiment from the book The Field, and Kevin Trudeau calls it hard, repeatable evidence that your mind can bend pure chance.

#kevintrudeau #manifestation #lawofattraction #mindsetmatters #quantumfield #successhabits

Here's the test Kevin Trudeau says is the real proof. Researchers ran the random number generator first, completely alone, no one in the room, until it finished a full billion-number cycle.

Only after it was already done did they bring in the test subject and ask them to pick either a 1 or a 0 - then focus on wanting more of that number.

The results were already locked in before the person even walked through the door. And every single time, whatever number the person wanted was the number that showed up more.

The outcome was set before the intention even existed. How do you explain that?

#kevintrudeau #manifestation #lawofattraction #mindsetmatters #quantumfield #successhabits

Back in the mid-1970s, a young Kevin Trudeau sat in a school auditorium at a Boy Scout raffle with maybe a hundred tickets in the drawing.

He'd just learned a technique for broadcasting intention on a specific brainwave frequency, the same science described in the book The Field. So he quietly decided: I want to win.

The first prize was called - not him. The second prize was called - not him. Then they pulled the third ticket and read his name before he even reached the stage. He says he saw it coming that clearly.

That was the moment he knew luck wasn't random for him anymore.

#kevintrudeau #manifestation #lawofattraction #mindsetmatters #successstory #quantumfield

Researchers took DNA from a person and placed it in a lab dish, then showed that same person violent war images - and the DNA in the dish, with no physical connection, contracted at the exact same instant.

So they pushed it further: moved the DNA to a lead-lined room on the opposite side of the planet, somewhere no cell signal could reach.

Same result, no delay. Disturbing images made it contract instantly. Positive images made it expand instantly, thousands of miles away.

Kevin Trudeau says this is the science behind why distance never actually separates you from anything.
